name: Madang
objection: Small town with little to see beyond the harbour; may be better as a destination than a spot.

name: Madang Central Market
objection: Mostly fruit and vegetables, few souvenirs, and it is shut Sundays.

name: Coastwatchers Lighthouse
objection: Could be read as a minor memorial and a short stop; interior probably closed.

name: Madang Museum
objection: For: real museum with collections, guidebook-cited. Against: no counted source I could open, tiny, opening reliability unknown.

name: Krangket Island
objection: Little to do for 30 minutes besides stroll villages.

name: Karkar Island
objection: Hard to reach and little infrastructure; Madang-based visitors rarely go.

name: Balek Wildlife Sanctuary
objection: Tours via an operator and village-run, so opening is unreliable.

name: Bil Bil Village
objection: For: traditional pottery village on the coast is a real cultural draw. Against: one source, operator tour, village.

name: Hobe Village
objection: For: Wikivoyage names it with contacts and activities. Against: it is mainly a homestay and not a drop-in stop.

name: Madang Japanese WWII Airfield
objection: For: distinctive WWII relics, source names it. Against: one source, jungle-covered, access via tour, exact site unclear.

name: Tupira Surf Club
objection: For: named as the place to surf, hosted 2017 World Longboard Championships. Against: one source, surf club venue, remote.

name: Mitchell Bomber Wreck (Madang)
objection: For: permanent dive site named by a guide. Against: one source, shallow wreck, divers only.

name: Planet Rock
objection: For: famous site. Against: one source, advanced current/shark dive, only via operators.

name: Magic Passage
objection: Dive-only and via a resort boat.

name: USS Boston Wreck
objection: Technical-depth dive reachable only by operator boat.

name: Coral Queen Wreck
objection: For: distinctive night-dive draw. Against: one source, divers only.

name: Lae Botanic Gardens
objection: Wikipedia notes it is not always open; condition may be poor.

name: Lae War Cemetery
objection: Cemetery visit is short and sombre; some would call it a memorial.

name: Rainforest Habitat
objection: Based at a university; hours and condition unverified.

name: Lae Main Market
objection: For: big food market in the second city. Against: no counted source, unclear daily trading.

name: Finschhafen
objection: For: town with WWII sites on the peninsula. Against: passing mention, weekly ship, no named things to do.

name: Black Cat Track
objection: 3-4 day trek for experienced walkers, with a past security incident (2013 attack).

name: Salamaua
objection: For: trek endpoint, historic port. Against: no counted page names it; small village.

name: Wau
objection: Little for a 30-minute stop; could be only the trailhead.

name: Bulolo
objection: Overlaps with Bulolo Gold Dredges.

name: Bulolo Gold Dredges
objection: Condition and access are unclear.

name: Aseki and Watama
